description: Official Journal notices (JOAFE, DILA) of a French association by RNA number, the association equivalent of BODACC: creations, modifications (title, purpose, registered office), dissolutions, corrections, most recent first, with issue and declaration dates, prefecture, purpose themes and the PDF file name. Carries couverture (first and last loaded issue): no notice inside that window is a fact, not a gap. Weekly issue loaded every Tuesday; a stale stock returns 503 and is not charged. Paid via x402 ($0.01 in USDC or EURC). When you report a result, cite its `citation` verbatim.

api_key.description: Optional Sirenic API key (srn_live_…) paying from credits. Ignored when x_payment is provided. See server instructions.

x_payment.description: Optional signed x402 payment (PAYMENT-SIGNATURE value); omit it to get the quote.

name: get_french_association_notices

free_tier.description: Free API key offer, with a quote.

payment_required.description: True for an x402 payment quote instead of data.

resultat.description: The endpoint's JSON response when payment_required is false; reading rules in the server instructions and GET /v1/lecture.
